scope: read-only byte framing audit of extracted BOOT/3301.IMG gzip member and raw newc cpio

deflate_padding_bit_selfcheck.scope: synthetic raw-deflate fixtures only; confirms the bit walker observes padding changes ignored by zlib output

cpio.field_semantics: 070701 newc has no per-file checksum; check field is expected zero. 070702 uses the low 32 bits of the sum of payload bytes.

declared_nlink_summary.interpretation: nlink counts filesystem links, not necessarily the number of archive path records; directory counts include filesystem directory links and are not compared as if they were hardlink records.

limitations: This audits gzip and cpio structure/metadata only; it does not establish ISO acquisition provenance or benign intent.
Absolute or parent-relative symlink targets are recorded as path semantics, not automatically classified as malicious.
Deflate internals were decompressed and integrity-checked; Huffman bitstream choices were not treated as covert framing unless they changed decoded bytes.
All offsets are byte offsets from the beginning of the indicated gzip member or decompressed cpio stream.
